title: Grammar: Prepositions in Phrases and Collocations
grammarTip:
Фиксированные предлоги — запомни комбинации:

Глаголы + предлоги:
depend on · consist of · belong to · apply for · deal with
result in · lead to · interfere with · contribute to · refer to

Прилагательные + предлоги:
responsible for · interested in · proud of · good at · different from
concerned about · aware of · capable of · suitable for

Существительные + предлоги:
reason for · solution to · impact on · attitude towards
demand for · increase in · need for

💡 Совет: учи фиксированные предлоги как часть фразы, не переводи логически!
"interested IN" (не "interested about/on")
"responsible FOR" (не "responsible of")
"different FROM" (не "different than/to")

grammarTable.subject: Verb + prep
grammarTable.verb: depend on, result in, consist of, rely on, apply for, belong to
grammarTable.example: "Success depends on preparation." "This results in confusion." "Apply for a visa."

grammarTable.subject: Adj + prep
grammarTable.verb: interested in, responsible for, proud of, aware of, familiar with, good at
grammarTable.example: "She is interested in Korean culture." "He is responsible for the tour."

grammarTable.subject: Noun + prep
grammarTable.verb: attitude to/towards, lack of, increase in, reason for, impact on
grammarTable.example: "The reason for the delay." "The impact on local communities."

grammarTable.subject: Phrasal (travel)
grammarTable.verb: check in/out, set off, get off, take off, touch down
grammarTable.example: "We checked in at 3pm." "The plane took off on time." "We set off at dawn."

grammarTable.subject: Prep phrases (travel)
grammarTable.verb: on time, in time, on arrival, in advance, by mistake
grammarTable.example: "The train left on time." "Book in advance." "She took the wrong bag by mistake."

grammarTable.subject: Contrast: in / at / on in collocations
grammarTable.verb: in order, at risk, on holiday, in trouble, at last
grammarTable.example: "She is on holiday." "He is at risk." "They are in trouble." "At last, we arrived."

rows.form: depend on / rely on
rows.example: "Cultural exchange depends on openness." "We rely on local guides."

rows.form: result in / lead to
rows.example: "Overtourism results in environmental damage." "Poor planning leads to frustration."

rows.form: consist of / be made up of
rows.example: "The tour consists of three days in Istanbul and two in Cappadocia."

rows.form: apply for / apply to
rows.example: "She applied for a visa." "This rule applies to all visitors."

rows.form: belong to / refer to
rows.example: "The artefact belongs to the local museum." "'Nunchi' refers to reading social situations."

rows.form: deal with / cope with
rows.example: "Local communities must deal with the effects of overtourism."

rows.form: interested in / good at / skilled at
rows.example: "She is interested in cultural anthropology." "He is good at languages."

rows.form: responsible for / famous for / known for
rows.example: "Who is responsible for the tourism policy?" "Venice is famous for its canals."

rows.form: aware of / proud of / tired of / afraid of
rows.example: "Travellers should be aware of cultural norms." "She is proud of her heritage."

rows.form: similar to / different from / compared to
rows.example: "Korean collectivism is similar to, but different from, Kazakh traditions."

rows.form: familiar with / satisfied with / disappointed with
rows.example: "Are you familiar with the local customs?" "She was disappointed with the service."

rows.form: sensitive to / open to / opposed to
rows.example: "Responsible travellers are sensitive to local norms." "He is open to new experiences."

rows.form: impact on / effect on / influence on
rows.example: "Tourism has a huge impact on local economies." "The effect on the environment is severe."

rows.form: attitude to / towards + noun/gerund
rows.example: "Her attitude towards foreign visitors is welcoming."

rows.form: lack of / shortage of / absence of
rows.example: "A lack of cultural awareness leads to misunderstanding."

rows.form: reason for / need for / demand for
rows.example: "The reason for the delay was unclear." "There is growing demand for sustainable travel."

rows.form: increase in / rise in / decline in
rows.example: "There has been a sharp increase in international tourism."

rows.form: access to / solution to / reaction to
rows.example: "Access to affordable travel has expanded." "Her reaction to the culture shock was positive."

rows.form: on time = punctually
rows.example: "The flight left on time." (at the right moment)

rows.form: in time = not too late
rows.example: "We arrived in time to see the sunset." (with time to spare)

rows.form: on arrival = when arriving
rows.example: "On arrival, guests are given a key."

rows.form: in advance = before the event
rows.example: "Book your visa in advance." "I knew about it in advance."

rows.form: by mistake = accidentally
rows.example: "She took the wrong bag by mistake."

rows.form: on holiday / on a trip / on a tour
rows.example: "They are on holiday in Turkey." "We went on a trip to Almaty."

rows.form: ❌ She is interested about Korean culture.
rows.example: ✅ She is interested in Korean culture.

rows.form: ❌ This results from environmental damage.
rows.example: ✅ This results in environmental damage. (result in = cause)

rows.form: ❌ He is responsible of the booking.
rows.example: ✅ He is responsible for the booking.

rows.form: ❌ She is familiar of local customs.
rows.example: ✅ She is familiar with local customs.

rows.form: ❌ The tour consists in three excursions.
rows.example: ✅ The tour consists of three excursions.
